title: Velvety Pork Skewers with German Flavor
description: A delicious and easy-to-make pork skewer recipe with a velvety twist, inspired by traditional German flavors.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose lean pork for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Velvety sauce (see instructions)
ingredients.notes: You can also use store-bought velvety sauce

ingredients.name: German mustard
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild or spicy German mustard to your taste

ingredients.name: Vegetable skewers (wooden or metal)
ingredients.notes: Pre-soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: You can also use other neutral-tasting oils

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (180°C / 350°F).
In a large bowl, whisk together velvety sauce, German mustard, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce mixture.
Thread the pork cubes onto the vegetable skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 71°C (160°F).
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley (if using).
Serve the skewers hot with additional velvety sauce on the side (if desired).
